name: player-idle-0
layout: horizontal strip, one slice per frame
y_offset_note: source px; at scale 4 lift 4 px per slice (draw each slice 4x at 1 px steps for solid walls)
y_squash_note: the game (index.html ss_bakeOne, SS_SQUASH = 0.62) squashes EVERY Minesweeper stack after rotating; previews here use the same 0.62 so the player matches the board
pivot_note: rotate every slice about its centre; slice 0 centre = the ground point under the player
forward: +y in slice space (down in each slice image) = the way the face looks
forward_note: at rotation 0 the player faces the camera (south). To face world direction (dc, dr) blit at yaw - Math.atan2(dc, dr)
palette: colours sampled from Phill's player-ref.jpg (cream, red, brown, green face, blue/cream flag)
empty_slices_note: every frame has the same slice count; unused slices stay empty (top headroom for bob/hop; bottom slices of airborne hop frames = pose.air)
